name: Charminar
description: Iconic 16th-century four-minaret mosque and monument in the heart of old city, surrounded by Laad Bazaar.

name: Golconda Fort
description: Massive medieval citadel fortress famous for acoustic system, Fateh Rahben cannon, diamond trade history, and evening sound-and-light show.

name: Hussain Sagar Lake
description: Historic heart-shaped lake built in 1563, featuring monolithic Buddha statue, boat cruises, and evening promenade.

name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
description: Granite domed mausoleums of the seven ruling Sultans of the Qutb Shahi dynasty set amidst landscaped gardens.

name: Chowmahalla Palace
description: Magnificent 18th-century palace of the Nizams of Hyderabad featuring grand courtyards, vintage cars, and ornate chandeliers.

name: Salar Jung Museum
description: One of the three National Museums of India housing an extraordinary collection of sculptures, paintings, and the famous Veiled Rebecca.

name: Birla Mandir
description: Majestic Hindu temple built of 2000 tons of white Rajasthani marble perched on Naubat Pahad hill overlooking the city.

name: Ramoji Film City
description: World's largest integrated film studio complex with film sets, live stunt shows, amusement rides, and adventure activities.

name: Laad Bazaar
description: Vibrant old-city bazaar adjacent to Charminar famous for lacquer bangles, pearls, traditional attars, and Hyderabadi street food.

name: Red Fort
description: 17th-century Mughal fortress in Old Delhi built by Shah Jahan, constructed from red sandstone.

name: Qutub Minar
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site and the world's tallest brick minaret, built in 1192 surrounded by ancient ruins.

name: Humayun's Tomb
description: Splendid Mughal garden tomb that inspired the Taj Mahal architecture, set in symmetric charbagh gardens.

name: India Gate
description: All India War Memorial archway honoring fallen soldiers, popular for evening family strolls and ice cream.

name: Chandni Chowk
description: Historic market of Old Delhi bustling with famous Paranthe Wali Gali, spice markets, sweets, and historic havelis.

name: Baga Beach
description: Lively beach destination in North Goa famed for water sports, beach shacks, nightlife, and golden sand sunset views.

name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
description: UNESCO World Heritage church in Old Goa holding the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier, stunning baroque architecture.

name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
description: Four-tiered majestic sea of milk waterfall on Mandovi river nestled amidst dense Western Ghats jungle.

name: Fort Aguada
description: 17th-century Portuguese lighthouse and fort overlooking the Arabian Sea and Sinquerim beach.

name: Amber Fort
description: Hilltop fortress palace featuring magnificent Sheesh Mahal mirror palace, artistic Rajput architecture, and Maota Lake views.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: Palace of Winds with 953 honeycombed jharokha windows built of pink sandstone for royal ladies to view street festivals.

name: City Palace
description: Royal residence blending Rajput and Mughal architecture, containing museums of royal costumes, weapons, and courtyards.

name: Jantar Mantar
description: UNESCO World Heritage 18th-century astronomical observatory featuring the world's largest stone sundial.

name: Gateway of India
description: Iconic arch monument built during British Raj overlooking Mumbai harbour and Arabian Sea, adjacent to Taj Mahal Palace.

name: Marine Drive
description: 3.6 km long arc-shaped boulevard along coast known as Queen's Necklace, iconic for sunset strolls and sea breeze.

name: Elephanta Caves
description: UNESCO rock-cut cave temples dedicated to Shiva on Gharapuri Island accessible by ferry from Gateway of India.

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
description: 240-acre botanical garden with century-old trees, glass house inspired by Crystal Palace, and famous flower shows.

name: Bangalore Palace
description: Tudor-revival architectural palace surrounded by green gardens, featuring wooden carvings, paintings, and ballroom.

name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
description: The main and most spectacular ghat on Ganges river, renowned for the mystical evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.

name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
description: One of the twelve holy Jyotirlinga Shiva temples, with gold-plated spires, situated in the ancient spiritual heart of Kashi.

name: Taj Mahal
description: Immense white marble mausoleum built by Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal, recognized universally as jewel of Muslim art and World Wonder.

name: Agra Fort
description: UNESCO World Heritage massive red sandstone fortress that was the main residence of the Mughal emperors until 1638.

name: Fort Kochi & Chinese Nets
description: Historic seaside promenade with cantilevered Chinese fishing nets, colonial mansions, art cafes, and spice fragrance.

name: Victoria Memorial
description: Grand white Makrana marble monument dedicated to Queen Victoria, housing 25 galleries of rare British and Indian artwork.

name: Marina Beach
description: Second longest urban beach in the world, lively with food stalls, lighthouse, sea waves, and cool evening breeze.

name: City Palace Udaipur
description: Sprawling palace complex built over 400 years on Lake Pichola with balconies, cupolas, towers, and mirror work.

name: Golden Temple
description: Holiest Gurdwara of Sikhism covered with real gold, surrounded by holy Amrit Sarovar lake and serving 100000 free meals daily in Langar.

name: Solang Valley
description: Side valley at top of Kullu Valley offering paragliding, zorbing, quad biking, skiing in winter, and panoramic mountain views.

name: Mysore Palace
description: Historical palace and royal residence of Wadiyar dynasty, illuminated by 100000 lights on weekends and Dasara.

name: Triveni Ghat & Laxman Jhula
description: Holy confluence of Ganga, Yamuna and Saraswati with evening Maha Aarti, suspension bridges, and Himalayan river views.

name: Mall Road & Ridge
description: Pedestrian-only cultural hub in the heart of Shimla with colonial architecture, Christ Church, cafes, and scenic valley views.
